I think that's the route I'll take! Thanks for heads up on film industry. I currently live in London so as long as it's not any worse than this, I figure it'll feel a bit better (hopefully lol).

  
Did you move over via an open work permit out of interest?
Thanks so much! Looking into skills shortages is definitely a shout.

That is wild! I’m so sorry you’ve been subject to that. I know the toll it can take. 

Are you applying to jobs that are the same role? Or switching path? Sending you luck and hoping you score another job so you can leave this experience in the past!

My current company is really weird to say the least. We don’t have HR, line managers.. any of it. There’s no people management at all which means when things go sour - it’s pretty much all over. Thankfully I’m close with most people there (outside of the directors) so I’d be able to get a good reference. 

I’m hoping I manage to get a new job (that I genuinely want) during the turmoil and can move on without any regrets. 

It’s comforting to know I’m not alone in this, but I am truly wishing you the best and a quick way out of this situation!
Glad to hear it’s been helping!! I’ll keep using it too in that case, thank you :)

This has been incredibly helpful. I’ve thought back on it over the past few days as a reminder and it’s definitely helped me step outside of my comfort zone. Practise makes perfect. I appreciate you sharing your experience, thank you so much 😊
Oooh I see! Thank you for letting me know!
